record.t: Was elected Vice President of the National Conference of State Legislatures by legislators from across the country.
record.q: In 2025, Bob’s colleagues from across the country elected him Vice President of the National Conference of State Legislatures (NCSL)

record.t: Led the 2017 rewrite of the state's education funding formula (ECS).
record.q: As Senate Majority Leader, Bob is most proud of his role in leading the 2017 rewrite of the state’s decades-old education funding formula (“ECS”)

record.t: Was chosen by his colleagues to serve as Connecticut Senate Majority Leader (2015).
record.q: Bob was chosen by his colleagues in 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023 and 2025 to serve as Senate Majority Leader.

record.t: Served as the representative for Norwalk's 137th Assembly District in the state House of Representatives for three years before joining the Senate in 2004.
record.q: Prior to his election to the Senate in 2004, Bob represented Norwalk’s 137th Assembly District in the House of Representatives for three years.
